title: SessionSetPermissionMode
description: Changes the permission mode of a running session.

mode.description: The canonical mode (plan 28, D-16): `ask` — every call that needs leave asks; `acceptEdits` — file edits are accepted, the rest asks; `readOnly` — nothing changes: the server refuses every write and every shell, whatever the engine thinks; `allowAll` — Permitir tudo, ours: the server allows every call no rule refuses, but questions and plans (ADR-022). Only the modes the engine announces in `capabilities.permissionModes` are offered.
